Trace, implement and test: joins2bms

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
select distinct s.bus_no, b.bus_name
from schedule s join buses b
on s.bus_no = b.bus_no
where (s.source, s.destination) = any (
select s.destination, s.source 
from schedule s)
order by s.bus_no;
source: Cognizant-GenC-Learn-main/SQL/Buses based on Source and Destination/joins2bms.sql
